exit 0

== TLS 1.3
a stapled certificate:
  1: resumed false ocsp 'an OCSP response' scts ["sct one", "sct two"]
no staple:
  1: resumed false ocsp '' scts []
only SCTs:
  1: resumed false ocsp '' scts ["just one"]
resumed, the session's again:
  1: resumed false ocsp 'an OCSP response' scts ["sct one", "sct two"]
  2: resumed true ocsp 'an OCSP response' scts ["sct one", "sct two"]
get_certificate's:
  1: resumed false ocsp 'an OCSP response' scts ["sct one", "sct two"]
== TLS 1.2
a stapled certificate:
  1: resumed false ocsp 'an OCSP response' scts ["sct one", "sct two"]
no staple:
  1: resumed false ocsp '' scts []
